title: Heatmap
description: A calendar of intensity — the contribution-graph pattern, for activity that has rhythm.
usage: For activity over weeks: deploys, posts, workouts, commits. Five steps of one accent; anything more and the steps stop being comparable.
a11y: A chart is a picture of numbers: give the figure role="img" and an aria-label that states the conclusion ("Signups rose from 22 to 71 over the year"), and keep the data available as a table nearby.
